archive.title: Sanskrit & Trika Shaivism: downloadable IAST scriptures
archive.description: A Sanskrit transliteration archive, not a collection of English translations. The inspected archive contained 20 RTF files; three filenames said EMPTY and two said UNFINISHED. Anuttarāṣṭikā was not present in that snapshot.
archive.attribution: Gabriel Pradīpaka and the Sanskrit & Trika Shaivism team; the website credits Ivan Nandī for compiling the transliterations.

works.title: Bhairavastava
works.author: Abhinavagupta
works.description: Also called Bhairavastotram. The opening words match our work, but their editions do not agree on every reading.
works.editorial_note: Verse 1 illustrates why editions matter: our reader has tvanmayacittatayā, while Pradīpaka's page has tanmayacittatayā. Record the difference before comparing translations; its witness history is not yet established.

works.title: Pratyabhijñāhṛdaya
works.author: Kṣemarāja
works.description: The twenty sūtras and their autocommentary have separate pages. The downloaded IAST archive contains the twenty sūtras; its commentary file is marked empty.
works.editorial_note: The separate translation-work passage ledger still groups sūtras 1–4 under one locator while storing only sūtra 1 in that row. This does not mean the reader's separately assembled 20-sūtra projection is missing the other sūtras. Source-span and lineage repair remain open.
